subject: gse/overnight-sprint
body: Overnight work complete: keyless data-refresh active (16/16 vitest), cylindrical temporal solver verified (15/15 pytest), Monte Carlo copula offline sampler operational (10,000 draws -> data/snapshots/sgp_copula_sample.npy). TWO HONEST RESULTS: (1) the +57% structural edge in the brief is the NOTEBOOK'S 2-leg demo (+57.86% reproduced exactly); the 4-leg parlay measures +343% -- both printed side by side, neither tuned. (2) The cylindrical decay ratio is 0.970559, NOT 0.9834 -- 1.31% off the stated target, and the trace is non-monotone. The circulation-variable pole-regular cure was tested and FAILS (ratio 86.6, more positive eigenvalues). Separately CORRECTED: the -u/r^2 term is NOT a cylindrical coordinate artifact -- a Cartesian componentwise Laplacian of the same field matches the vector form to 1e-8 and disagrees with the scalar form by ~2-4, so the earlier amendment's explanation was wrong. Pinned by a regression test.
